workstream: fixture scheduler recovery and cleanup confinement

candidate_membership.formula: Sort path; append path, TAB, lowercase SHA-256 without prefix, LF; SHA-256 the concatenation.

base_membership.rule: Use its exact 26 current rows; replace the five rows below and add the lease-identity WorkerResult control row, then sort all 27 paths.

candidate_membership.unchanged_row_revalidation: All 21 unchanged rows matched the prior binding exactly in the same root session.

changed_subset.aggregate_note: WorkerResult-v1 does not enforce this aggregate field. Root independently derived membership, rows, totals, and the path-bound set digest; review and any acceptance must use the root values.

required_behavior: lease-root and every scheduler-created child identity remain pinned across cleanup and recovery
root, directory, regular-file, symlink, and special-file substitutions fail closed without deleting replacement or outside data
check/use swaps after public-name validation cannot redirect deletion
failed recovery retains a causal retry handle and successful retry remains idempotent
detached-descendant, network, outside-write, resource, output, backend, policy, and supplied-outcome controls remain intact
requested_route: fresh independent security and recovery review of the exact 27-file candidate
invalidation_rule: Any change to the 27 candidate paths, this binding, the WorkerResult, or the referenced base binding invalidates the review.
claim_ceiling: private source candidate pending independent review; no public integration or product claim
no_claim_statement: This binding does not claim fixture acceptance, public integration, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion.
